name: Install-method code explorer
purpose: A photographic panel holding a tab row and a copyable terminal, letting a developer see the install command for their tool of choice. The homepage's 'Developers' section.

motion.detail: Tab background/color transitions at 100ms ease-out. The terminal body is pinned at a constant 80px on every tab so switching never resizes the card.

layoutNote: A single flex COLUMN — header, then a full-bleed panel, then the CTA row. NOT a 2-column grid with text left and code right.

accessibility.copyAction: a real clipboard write guarded in a try/catch; failure is a silent no-op
